lang: Hebrew (English summary pp. 160-161 included in the PDF)
location_note: Antebi Street, Nahalat Ahim quarter, Jerusalem; map ref. NIG 22009/63179, OIG 17009/13179.
notes: Arcosolia burial cave with 51 individuals, 63 lamps and 18 glass vessels; use from the end of the 3rd c. to c. 614 CE. Two other burial caves in the quarter (a late Second Temple kokhim cave; a robbed cave found in 1935) are cited from earlier records; not coded. The PDF's summary page also carries the start of the next article's summary (Horbat Gores burial cave, 'Atiqot 54, pp. 87*-94*), which is not this unit and is not coded.

features.subtype: rock-hewn burial cave: square vaulted chamber L4 with three arcosolia, two troughs each, blocking stone
features.period: end of the 3rd c. CE to the beginning of the 7th c. CE
features.quote: Three steps descend to a square burial chamber (L4)
